build.beforeBuildCommand: node scripts/prepare-widgetjs.mjs && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit && node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; frame-src http://widget.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'
security.devCsp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:1420 ws://127.0.0.1:1420; frame-src http://widget.localhost; object-src 'none'
